next_action: Do not use a prescribed pushdown trace to create difficulty in a miniature engine.
notes: Source incident retained. Root review rejected the miniature name-to-ordinal repair before implementation; a prescribed optimizer trace was not a sufficiently natural way to rule out correct alternatives. No model trial.

title: Ordinal-safe filter pushdown through duplicate labels
why_hard: Output ordinal, display label, source expression, and predicate scope are distinct. A label-only lookup can redirect a filter onto the wrong side of a left join while leaving the plan superficially plausible.
